Assign sampling sites to cross-validation folds

Source: R/spatial_cv.R
terradish_folds.Rd

Creates either spatially blocked folds by k-means clustering projected site coordinates or balanced random folds. Fold labels can also be supplied directly to terradish_cv_folds when study-specific blocks are more defensible than an automated partition.

Usage

terradish_folds(
  pts,
  k = 5L,
  method = c("spatial_kmeans", "random"),
  seed = 1L,
  projected = NULL,
  nstart = 25L
)

Arguments

pts

Focal-site coordinates as a terra::SpatVector, matrix, or data frame.

k

Number of folds. Must be at least 2 and smaller than the number of sites.

method

Fold construction method. "spatial_kmeans" applies k-means to the unscaled projected coordinates. "random" assigns sites to balanced random folds.

seed

Optional random seed.

projected

Logical indicating whether the coordinates are projected. For spatial k-means with a SpatVector, NULL uses its coordinate reference system. For spatial k-means with a matrix or data frame, this argument must be supplied explicitly. It is ignored for random folds.

nstart

Number of random starts used by k-means.

Value

An integer vector of fold labels with attributes recording the construction method, seed, and number of folds.

Details

Coordinates are deliberately not standardized before spatial clustering. Consequently, Euclidean separation is measured in the map units of the projected coordinate reference system. Automated k-means blocks are a reproducible diagnostic, not a substitute for ecological blocking based on watersheds, barriers, sampling campaigns, or other design information.

See also

terradish_cv_folds

Other inference and model comparison: aic_table(), mlpe_response_change(), terradish_cv_folds(), terradish_ibe_ratio(), terradish_inference, terradish_rescale_nu()

Examples

data(melip)
coords <- terra::unwrap(melip.coords)

# The melip coordinates are longitude and latitude. Project them to a local
# azimuthal equidistant system centered on the sites, so that k-means
# distances are in meters.
lonlat <- terra::crds(coords)
local_crs <- sprintf(
  "+proj=aeqd +lat_0=%f +lon_0=%f +datum=WGS84 +units=m",
  mean(lonlat[, 2]), mean(lonlat[, 1]))
coords_projected <- terra::project(coords, local_crs)

folds <- terradish_folds(coords_projected, k = 3, seed = 1)
table(folds)   # number of sites in each spatial block
#> folds
#>  1  2  3 
#> 18  9 10
